QUOTE: "The handlers all extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`, so they share its helpers." and "`ServerDataOperatorBase.execute` ... `this.batchRecords(models, description)`" and "the base itself extends `BaseDataOperator`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says handlers extend ServerDataOperatorBase and that writes go through BaseDataOperator.batchRecords, but it never concludes that every handler's writes route through the inherited `batchRecords` because each mixin is constrained to ServerDataOperatorBase. It also lists handlers that call `batchRecords` directly or via `execute`, without tying that to the constraint.
